_comment: Copy to config/monitors/<team>.json, fill every REPLACE_… value, set enabled true, open a PR. Ids: channel C…, user group S… (from a raw <!subteam^S…|name> mention), user U…. Validate with: node plugins/rota-triage/scripts/monitor.js validate --monitor <team>

agent1.agentId: REPLACE agent id of a team-owned Agent1 agent (Slack MCP bound, kibana plugin)
agent1.boardId: REPLACE team board id (runs and cost show up there)
agent1.keyOwner: REPLACE firstname.lastname whose personal Agent1 key runs the task

output.signature: 🤖 automated triage by rota-triage on behalf of @REPLACE-usergroup — a human from the team will follow up; reply here if this is wrong
